title: Experiment Variation: Varying Code Granularity in AI Vulnerability Scanning (File vs. Function vs. Line)

original_idea.body:
# Experiment Variation: Varying Code Granularity in AI Vulnerability Scanning (File vs. Function vs. Line)

**Problem:** AI vulnerability scanners can be given varying granularities of code context. Optimal context window size for detection is not characterized.

**Direction:** Run the same AI vulnerability scanner on the same 20 vulnerable code samples at three context granularities: individual function, file-level, and cross-file (with imports/dependencies). Measure detection rate and false positive rate per granularity. Compute cost-performance trade-off.

**Why it matters:** Context granularity affects both detection performance and API cost. Understanding the optimal granularity enables cost-effective deployment.

**Relevant context:** LLM context window size impacts performance (general ML literature). Security-specific optimal context granularity not studied. LLMs in Vulnerability Detection survey (arXiv 2502.07049).
